J1.evidence: Source: الفاء عاطفة على تقدير إذا كنتم فعلتم ذلك فتوبوا. إذا is a conditional/temporal particle ('if/when you have done that, then repent'). English renders it 'since you have done that', which turns it into a causal assertion and does not translate the conditional the grammarian uses to explain the fāʾ. It should read 'if (or: when) you have done that, then repent'. The rest of the English is complete.

It should be 'if/when you have done that…'.
